rules.description: Taxable turnover has exceeded £90,000 in any rolling 12-month period
rules.reason_if_failed: Your turnover has not exceeded the mandatory VAT registration threshold of £90,000

rules.description: Taxable turnover is expected to exceed £90,000 in the next 30 days
rules.reason_if_failed: Your expected turnover does not meet the mandatory registration threshold within 30 days

rules.description: Business makes or intends to make taxable supplies in the UK
rules.reason_if_failed: You must make taxable supplies to register for VAT. Businesses making only exempt supplies cannot register.

rules.description: Business is established or has a fixed establishment in the UK
rules.reason_if_failed: Non-UK businesses must follow the non-resident VAT registration process

rules.description: Business type is eligible for VAT registration
rules.reason_if_failed: Your business type requires specialist VAT registration guidance

rules.description: Business is not already registered for VAT
rules.reason_if_failed: This business is already registered for VAT. Use the VAT management service to update details.

explanation_template: VAT registration eligibility: {outcome}. Registration is mandatory if turnover exceeds £90,000, or voluntary below this threshold to reclaim VAT on business purchases.

edge_cases.description: Business sells goods to UK customers from outside the UK (distance selling)
edge_cases.action: Distance selling threshold of £70,000 applies. Route to distance selling VAT guidance.

edge_cases.description: Business acquires goods from EU exceeding £85,000
edge_cases.action: Must register for VAT immediately even if UK turnover below threshold. Route to acquisition VAT guidance.

edge_cases.description: Multiple related companies want to register as a VAT group
edge_cases.action: Requires VAT group registration (VAT51). Hand off to HMRC VAT specialist team.

edge_cases.description: Non-UK business making supplies in UK
edge_cases.action: May require VAT representative or security deposit. Route to overseas business VAT team.

edge_cases.description: Turnover exceeded threshold more than 30 days ago (late registration)
edge_cases.action: Penalties may apply for late registration. Flag for compliance review during processing.
